title: My First Steam Game Goes Live Tomorrow (And I've only got 52 wishlists... wish me luck!)
author: luzzotica
selftext:
When I was 10 I played Wii Tanks! for the first time, and for the past 20 years I have dreamed of making my own version.

Now, that dream becomes a reality and THEN SOME because of Grok/Claude/AI in general.

Man am I so grateful for these tools God has blessed us with.



This post is kind of a "premortem"



\- I've released probably over 100 videos on it (my claude skill is getting better... still not amazing)

\- Reached out to a few streamers and got responses but bungled getting them steam keys...

\- Submitted my game steam late (it's still under review even though it's supposed to launch tomorrow... so fingers crossed).

As for the 52 wishlists... I don't think I ever got on Steam's happy algorithm to boost me.

I probably made EVERY possible mistake I could have made from a marketing standpoint!



Hence, a premortem! 



I don't expect this game to pop off or make me a lot of money. I expect it to get me started. To get my foot in the door. To help me connect with other awesome gamers, and game devs!

And I am SOOO FETCHING HAPPY TO BE HERE! And I am proud of this game.

Because my dream is coming true, even if I only get to play this game with my wife and kids and friends!

That is all my friends.  
If you want to enjoy a nostalgic, top down, tank shooter with bouncing bullets, soccer, multiplayer, and then some, Tankii is for you!

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971410/Tankii/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971410/Tankii/)

What about the first few seconds left you scratching your head? I definitely want to improve the trailers.

comments.author: forgingtheflow
comments.body: Good luck with your launch, how has your demo gone: had many downloads?

replies.author: luzzotica
replies.body: 974 downloads on the demo! So my conversion rate is horrendous... lol

replies.author: forgingtheflow
replies.body:
See, people could be downloading the demo to decide if they want Wishlist. 900+ downloads seem like a good number.  
Are they playing for any reasonable length of time. I don’t know what length of time is good or now, likely depends on each game.

comments.author: Mother-Hedgehog-5628
comments.body:
why would you not spend like a couple of days actually creating stylized assets for it using blender MCP or something? 

it looks fun but also comes off as a prototype rather than obviously "stylized", e.g. small things such as the turret rotations being instant sometimes feels off to me - you have a really good foundation but you should polish it, you can only release once...

replies.author: luzzotica
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback! If you're talking about the intro video then I can see what you mean. I don't really show many of the skins/effects/etc. I've got built. 

The turret turn is instant for players so it always shoots where they aim. Having it lag behind didn't work too well. Though I could just have it be a visual thing for players.
